title: Velkyn Kthonia
dek: An investigator who argues that theft and killing require different judgments, then helps turn a running fight toward a conditional truce.

facts.Approach: Question motives before deciding an outcome
facts.Agreement: A pause in raids for a meeting with the First Hunter
facts.Status: The meeting and any lasting trade arrangement remain ahead

sources: Quest RP refreshed source · supplied 23 October 2026 · 3,845 messages across the main channel and two accessible threads; posting chronology and narrated continuations remain distinct
body:
Velkyn joins Vessalia, Thorn and Clive to investigate raids on a merchant’s caravans. He asks whether need, rather than simple malice, may explain thefts that have left the workers alive.

Questions before the road

He asks about the attacks’ lethality and suggests hearing the thieves’ reasons. The merchant cannot establish their motives. His distinction between theft and murder is his judgment here, not a statement of a universal legal code.

Scene references: 1, 2, 3.

The argument survives the fight

The disguised caravan is attacked despite offers to talk. Velkyn is badly hurt while fighting the slasher, and later renews the offer to listen. He proposes that raids cease in exchange for a meeting with the First Hunter. The raider agrees to hold off while asking the adventurers to hear that leader out.

Scene references: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5.

The agreement’s limits

The raider says food is needed and reports distrust of the towns’ religious commitments. Neither claim proves the whole tribe’s motives or the towns’ actual policy. Velkyn recognizes Mama Tabitha’s cottage as a landmark on the supplied map; the meeting place is west of it, not the cottage itself. No meeting, new trade route or permanent peace is completed in these scenes.

Scene references: 1, 2, 3.
